# BreedFinder

> Find your perfect dog breed. BreedFinder profiles 220+ dog breeds with expert ratings, side-by-side comparisons, a breed-matching quiz, and lifestyle guides — available in 16 languages.

BreedFinder helps prospective and current dog owners choose the right breed for their lifestyle. Every breed is rated across eight practical dimensions (size, energy, grooming, sociability, trainability, barking, kid-friendliness, and apartment suitability) and described with overview, history, temperament, health, grooming, and exercise sections, plus a plain-language verdict of who the breed is and isn't right for.

## Key Facts

- 220+ dog breeds profiled with structured ratings and editorial write-ups
- ~3,000 head-to-head breed comparison pages (English), generated from the breed dataset
- 6 lifestyle guide articles (apartments, families, seniors, hypoallergenic, low-shedding, low-maintenance)
- An interactive breed-finder quiz and a breed search tool
- Available in 16 languages: English, Danish, German, Spanish, Finnish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, Turkish, and Chinese
- 6,600+ total pages across all languages
- Breed data is editorially curated and stored in a structured JSON dataset

## Sections

- [Breeds](https://breedfinder.org/breeds): Index of all dog breeds, each linking to a full profile
- [Breed profiles](https://breedfinder.org/breeds/golden-retriever/): Individual breed pages with ratings, characteristics, temperament, health, grooming, exercise needs, and a best-for / not-for verdict
- [Compare](https://breedfinder.org/compare/): Choose any two breeds to compare side by side
- [Comparisons](https://breedfinder.org/compare/comparisons/): Pre-built head-to-head comparison pages for popular breed pairings
- [Quiz](https://breedfinder.org/quiz/): Interactive breed-finder quiz that matches a breed to your lifestyle and preferences
- [Search](https://breedfinder.org/search/): Search breeds by name or alias
- [Articles](https://breedfinder.org/articles/): Lifestyle guides such as best dogs for apartments, families, seniors, hypoallergenic breeds, and low-shedding breeds
- [FAQ](https://breedfinder.org/faq/): Frequently asked questions about choosing and caring for dogs
- [About](https://breedfinder.org/about/): About BreedFinder and how breeds are rated
- [Sitemap](https://breedfinder.org/sitemap.xml): Full XML sitemap of all pages across every language

## URL Patterns

- Breed profile: `https://breedfinder.org/breeds/{breed-id}/` (e.g. `/breeds/labrador-retriever/`)
- Breed comparison: `https://breedfinder.org/compare/comparisons/{breed-a}-vs-{breed-b}/` (e.g. `/compare/comparisons/labrador-vs-golden-retriever/`)
- Article guide: `https://breedfinder.org/articles/{slug}/` (e.g. `/articles/best-dogs-for-families/`)
- Localized pages: `https://breedfinder.org/{lang}/...` where `{lang}` is one of `da`, `de`, `es`, `fi`, `fr`, `it`, `ja`, `nl`, `no`, `pl`, `pt`, `ru`, `sv`, `tr`, `zh` (e.g. `/de/breeds/golden-retriever/`). Localized URLs mirror the English structure with translated breed slugs.

## Rating Dimensions

Each breed is scored 1–5 on: size, energy level, grooming needs, sociability, trainability, barking tendency, kid-friendliness, and apartment suitability. Profiles also include group, country of origin, lifespan, height/weight, coat type and colors, shedding level, hypoallergenic status, and temperament traits.

## Data Sources

- Breed data is editorially curated by BreedFinder and stored as a structured dataset (`data/breeds.json`).
- Ratings and verdicts reflect general breed characteristics and are intended as guidance, not a substitute for advice from breeders, veterinarians, or rescue organizations.

- Email: hello@breedfinder.org

## Notes

- This is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages.
- Information is general in nature; individual dogs vary. Always consult a veterinarian or qualified professional for decisions about a specific animal.
